purpose: Retrospective exploratory B/NB evaluator comparison; not a prospective confirmatory test or deployed arena reward

family_protocol.alignment: Biopython PairwiseAligner global; BLOSUM62; gap open -10; extension -0.5; first maximum-scoring alignment
family_protocol.primary: connected components of >=50% identity among aligned residue-residue positions AND >=80% residue-residue alignment coverage of both sequences
family_protocol.embedded_domain_guard: for length ratio <80%, shorter length >=40aa, require >=70% identity over aligned positions and >=90% coverage of shorter sequence
family_protocol.source_name_unions: explicit recognizable lineage/published-scaffold name rules only; author or tool alone not used
family_protocol.caveat: Operational conservative sequence/scaffold family proxies, not certified evolutionary families. Some unrelated antibody clones share framework and intentionally remain together. Distant shared topology can remain undetected.

metric_notes: Headline within-antigen AUROC/AP are test-size weighted means of heldout-fold metrics. Pooled out-of-fold ranking metrics are descriptive only.
All transformations fitted on training folds; fixed C=1; no class weighting, oversampling, hyperparameter search or post-hoc calibration.
Weak binding=B. Failed expression is not NB. No numerical KD is imputed or used as an input.
Training prevalence is the probability-quality control; its out-of-fold AP/ROC can deviate when pooled. Primary within-fold baseline AUROC=.5 and AP=test prevalence.
No operating threshold chosen. ROC/PR plots are for performance description, not test-set threshold selection.
Retrospective labels already examined; results are exploratory. Cross-target transfer also changes assay and design-selection process.
Existing energies are direct scores on unrelaxed predicted structures. No energy preparation or structure runs are performed.
Family clustering is a sequence/lineage proxy, not validated structural-family annotation.
